source.name: 得奇小说网

headers.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

rules.content:
<js>
const ids = /^https:\/\/www\.deqixss\.com\/books\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html$/.exec(baseUrl);
if (!ids) throw new Error('Invalid chapter address');
const root = 'https://www.deqixss.com';
const raw = java.ajax(root + '/scripts/chapter.js.php?aid=' + ids[1] + '&cid=' + ids[2] + '&referrer=' + encodeURIComponent(baseUrl));
const fields = /^\s*var chapterToken = '([a-f0-9]{32})';\s*var timestamp = (\d{10,16});\s*var nonce = '([a-f0-9]{8,64})';\s*var tokenUrl = '(https:\/\/www\.deqixss\.com\/books\/\d+\/\d+\.html)';\s*var SECRET_KEY = 'hidden';\s*$/.exec(raw);
if (!fields || fields[4] !== baseUrl) throw new Error('Invalid token data');
const url = root + '/modules/article/ajax2.php?aid=' + ids[1] + '&cid=' + ids[2] + '&token=' + fields[1] + '&timestamp=' + fields[2] + '&nonce=' + fields[3];
const response = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url + ',' + JSON.stringify({headers: {Referer: baseUrl, Accept: 'text/plain, */*; q=0.01', 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest'}})));
if (response.status !== 1 || !response.data || typeof response.data.content !== 'string' || !response.data.content.trim()) throw new Error('Chapter unavailable');
response.data.content;
</js>
